title: Partsmith protocol
description: The JSON header exactly as it appears on the wire.

buffers.description: Location and type of each raw buffer.

oneOf.description: A command from a client.
The engine's answer to one request.
A state change caused by the request answered in the same frame.

Command.description: Every command a client can send. Tagged by `type`; unknown types and fields are rejected.

oneOf.description: Engine and format versions.
Every registered feature type with its manifest and params JSON Schema, sorted by type.
Built-in printer profiles, then session profiles, each group sorted by id.
Adds or replaces a session (user) printer profile.

profile.description: The profile; omitted fields come from its technology's generic profile.

oneOf.description: Creates an empty document.
Parses, migrates and recomputes a `.ptsm` text.
Canonical `.ptsm` text plus every asset the document references.
Discards the document, its undo log and its display state.
The current recipe.
The host wrote the text that `save_document` returned for `revision`.

revision.description: The revision of the written text.

oneOf.description: Applies edits atomically.

label.description: Undo label; required outside a transaction and absent inside one.

oneOf.description: Renames a parameter and rewrites every expression that uses it.
Applies one `apply` action of a diagnostic, with its edits built from the current records (engine.md section 3.22).

fix.description: The action's fix, as the diagnostic offered it.

oneOf.description: Changes the document units; with `keep_sizes`, numbers without a unit get the old unit (engine.md section 3.25).

keep_sizes.description: Append the old unit to every number without a unit whose meaning the units decide, so no size changes.

oneOf.description: Opens a transaction; later `apply_edits` join it and are previewed.
Inside a transaction, previews the state before `feature` and the feature's own output.

feature.description: The focused feature; absent clears the focus.

oneOf.description: Records the transaction as one undo entry and clears the focus.
Reverts every edit of the transaction and clears the focus.
Reverts the newest undo entry.
Reapplies the newest redo entry.
Solves the stored sketch, or `candidate` params in its place, without recording anything.

candidate.description: Params to solve instead of the stored ones.

oneOf.description: Solves with `point` weakly pinned to `to`, starting from the previous drag frame. Not recorded.

to.description: Where the point is dragged to, in sketch coordinates.

oneOf.description: Ends a drag; with `commit`, writes the last drag solution into the sketch.

commit.description: Whether to record the dragged geometry.

oneOf.description: Sets the display quality and re-tessellates.
Evaluates an expression against the document's parameters and printer profile.
Every displayable element of a body at the display state.

kind.description: Only elements of this kind; all kinds when absent.

oneOf.description: Converts a pick in a current model-layer mesh into the element and its reference.
Resolves references at the display state and returns the matching mesh elements.

references.description: The references, each with its body.

oneOf.description: Measures one body or element at the display state.
What every feature uses, from the document alone, without recomputing (engine.md section 3.24).
Runs every printability check.

profile.description: Printer profile id; the document's resolved profile when absent.

orientation.description: How the bodies are placed on the bed.

bodies.description: Bodies to analyze; visible part bodies with geometry when absent.

oneOf.description: Exports bodies as files.

bodies.description: Bodies to export; every visible part body with geometry when absent.

tolerance.description: Mesh tolerances; derived from the printer profile when absent.

orientation.description: How the bodies are rotated; as modeled when absent.

oneOf.description: Stores a STEP file as an asset and adds one body and one `import` feature.
The document as a Python script.

ProfileInput.description:
The accepted JSON input: `id`, `name` and `technology` are required, every other field is
optional, and `fit` may name only some classes.

The protocol's `put_printer_profile` carries this type; `PrinterProfile::try_from` turns it
into a valid profile (section 3.1).

id.description: Profile id; validated as a `partsmith_model::Id` by the conversion (`InvalidId`).

technology.description: FDM or resin; selects the generic profile that fills omitted fields.

bed.description: Replaces the whole bed when present.

max_overhang_angle.description: Steepest printable overhang from vertical, in radians.

max_bridge_length.description: Longest unsupported horizontal span in mm.

fit.description: Replaces only the fit classes it names.

oneOf.description: Filament extrusion.
Masked or laser stereolithography (MSLA, SLA).

Bed.description:
Build plate shape and build volume height. Bed coordinates: a rectangle spans
`[0, width] × [0, depth]`; a circle is centered on the origin.

oneOf.description: Rectangular plate.
Round plate (delta printers).

FitInput.description: Fit clearances in a profile input, in mm; each class is optional.

Units.description: Document units: the unit of bare numbers in length expressions and the display unit for lengths.

oneOf.description: Millimeters, `"mm"`.
Centimeters, `"cm"`.
Meters, `"m"`.
Inches, `"in"`.

AssetData.description: A file passed into or out of the engine.

name.description: File name inside the document's `assets/` folder.

BufferIndex.description: Index of a buffer in the enclosing frame; serialized as a bare integer.

DocHandle.description: Handle of an open document; starts at 1 per session and is never reused.

Edit.description: One change to a document. Every change goes through an Edit; applying one returns its exact inverse.

oneOf.description: Inserts a parameter at `index` (0 to the number of parameters).
Replaces the parameter with the same id.
Removes a parameter.
Moves a parameter so that it ends up at `index`.
Inserts a body at `index`.
Replaces the body with the same id.
Removes a body.
Moves a body so that it ends up at `index`.
Inserts a feature record at timeline position `index`.

index.description: Timeline position of the new feature.

oneOf.description: Replaces the feature record with the same id.
Removes a feature record.
Moves a feature record so that it ends up at timeline position `index`.

index.description: Its timeline position after the move.

oneOf.description: Sets the rollback marker; `None` means nothing is rolled back.
Sets the document units.
Sets or clears the printer profile id.

Parameter.description: A named expression that other expressions use by name.

name.description: Name used in expressions; a valid parameter name, unique in the document.

comment.description: Free-text note shown next to the parameter.

Body.description: A declared solid body that features build into.

material.description: Material name such as "PETG"; a valid label when present.

visible.description: Shown in the viewport; default true, omitted when true.

BodyRole.description: What a body is for when it is printed.

oneOf.description: A printed part (default, omitted when saved).
Negative volume: subtracted by the slicer.
Region where the slicer must not place supports.
Region where the slicer must place supports.
Region with its own slicer settings (the settings themselves come later).

FeatureRecord.description: One timeline entry. Its params are stored generically and owned by the feature registry.

type.description: Feature type name such as "extrude"; serialized as "type".

name.description: Display name in the timeline; a valid label when present.

suppressed.description: Skipped by recompute; default false, omitted when false.

FixRef.description: Names one fix of one message at one revision; the engine builds the edits when it is applied (engine.md section 3.22).

feature.description: The feature whose message offers the fix (the sketch, for a profile finding).

field.description: The message's field; absent when the message has none.

cause.description: True for an action of the message's cause line.

index.description: Position of the action in the message's `actions`, or in its cause's `actions` when `cause` is true.

revision.description: The document revision the fix was offered at.

SketchParams.description: Params of a `sketch` feature; flattened into its feature record after the record's own fields (`id`, `type`, `name`, `suppressed`).

plane.description: Where the sketch lies in model space.

entities.description: Geometry in creation order; always written, a missing key loads as empty.

constraints.description: Constraints in creation order; always written, a missing key loads as empty.

oneOf.description: One of the three origin planes.
The plane produced by a datum feature, for example a `datum_plane`.
A planar face of `body`, plus the placement used when the face cannot be resolved and the coordinates it is in.

body.description: The body the face reference is resolved in.

fallback.description: The placement recorded when the sketch was attached.

fallback_frame.description: Which coordinates `fallback` is in; omitted from JSON when `World`.

OriginPlane.description: An origin plane, serialized as "XY", "XZ" or "YZ".

oneOf.description: Normal +Z, x axis +X.
Normal -Y, x axis +X, so sketch up is +Z.
Normal +X, x axis +Y, so sketch up is +Z.

Reference.description:
A stored reference to a face, edge or vertex: a name query, the fingerprint it had when picked,
what tells its order-dependent parts apart from their siblings, and the former names merged into
its faces (section 3.11).

A reference carries no body: it always sits next to a `body` field of its containing struct that
names the body it is resolved in.

q.description: The element name the reference was made with.

fp.description: The element's fingerprint when the reference was made.

nb.description: For each order-dependent part of the query, the faces it touched that its siblings did not.

merged.description: For each face name in the query, the former names merged into that face.

Anchors.description: Part name to the sorted, distinct piece-free names of at most `ANCHOR_LIMIT` faces.

Merged.description: Face name occurring in the query to the sorted, distinct former names merged into it.

Placement.description: A right-handed frame that places sketch coordinates in model space.

normal.description: Unit normal of the sketch plane; sketch +v is `normal x x_axis`.

HintFrame.description: Which coordinates a face sketch's `fallback` is in (section 3.1, features.md section 3.6).

oneOf.description: World coordinates: the default, and the meaning of every fallback written before file format version 2.
The coordinates of the face's own feature, before any later Move body or copy transform.

SketchEntity.description: The JSON record of an entity, with the `type` tag and the geometry fields at one level.

oneOf.description: A point entity.
A line entity.
A circle entity.
An arc entity.

TessellationQuality.description: Display and export tessellation quality relative to the printer profile.

oneOf.description: Coarser than the profile's tolerance, for fast display.
The profile's tolerance.
Finer than the profile's tolerance.

ElementKind.description: The topological kind of an element.

oneOf.description: A face.
An edge.
A vertex.

Pick.description: A pixel pick in a displayed mesh. In a headless session, which has no meshes, `mesh_id` is 0, `body` names the body and `index` is the element's position among the elements of its kind in `list_elements` order (engine.md section 3.9); in a display session `body` is absent or the mesh's body.

mesh_id.description: The displayed mesh; 0 in a headless session.

index.description: Display id of the element within the mesh; in a headless session, its position among the body's elements of its kind.

body.description: The body of a headless pick; absent, or the mesh's body, in a display session.

ElementRef.description: A face, edge or vertex reference with the body it is resolved in.

body.description: Body the reference is resolved in.

MeasureTarget.description: What to measure, resolved at the display state.

oneOf.description: A whole body.
A face, edge or vertex of `body`.

Orientation.description: How bodies are rotated onto the build plate.

oneOf.description: No rotation.
Rotation by a proper orthonormal 3 × 3 matrix, row-major.
The rotation that turns this planar face of `body` (outward normal) to -Z.

ExportFormat.description: Export file format and its options. A value enum inside the command, so it is tagged `kind`.

oneOf.description: STL; one file, or one per body.

per_body.description: One file per body instead of one file.

oneOf.description: 3MF with every exported body as an object.
Wavefront OBJ; one file with one object per body.
STEP AP214 B-rep with body names and colors.

TessellationTolerance.description: Tessellation accuracy: how far triangles may deviate from the exact surface.

chord_deviation.description: Chord deflection (OCCT `Deflection`, absolute): maximum distance between a triangle or segment and the exact surface or curve, in mm.

angular_deviation.description: Angular deflection (OCCT `Angle`): maximum angle between consecutive segments along curves and between adjacent triangle normals, in radians.

Request.description: A command with a client-chosen id.

id.description: Client-chosen id, echoed in the response; at most `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` (0 is reserved for the worker's own calls).

Outcome.description: Success or failure of one request. A value enum inside `Response`, so it is tagged `kind`.

oneOf.description: The command succeeded; its `type` equals the command's `type`.
The command failed and changed nothing.

manifest.description: Label, category, icon, version and inspector hints.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema of the feature's params.

FeatureManifest.description: Static description of a feature type for the UI, schema and registry.

label.description: Display name, for example "Extrude". Also the base of default feature labels.

icon.description: Icon name in the UI icon set, kebab-case, for example "linear-pattern".

version.description: Params version of this type, starting at 1. Bumped only with a document migration.

Category.description: Toolbar and palette group of a feature type.

oneOf.description: Sketches.
Features that add or remove material from scratch or from a sketch.
Features that change existing bodies.
Mirrors and patterns.
Construction geometry such as datum planes.

FieldHint.description: How the inspector shows one params field.

path.description: Path of the field inside params, for example `extent.expr` or `size[0]` (grammar in features.md section 3.2).

label.description: Label shown next to the field, for example "Distance".

essential.description: Shown without the "More" toggle. Default false, omitted when false.

unit.description: Value kind of an `Expr` field. Omitted for non-expression fields.

selection.description: What the viewport picks for a reference field. Omitted for typed fields.

options.description: Labels for the values of an enumeration or a tag field, in display order. Omitted when empty.

FieldUnit.description: Value kind of an expression field, which sets its input unit, its expected dimension and its validation.

oneOf.description: A length in millimeters (expected dimension `LENGTH`).
An angle in radians (expected dimension `ANGLE`).
A plain number (expected dimension `NONE`).
A plain non-negative whole number (expected dimension `NONE`).

SelectionKind.description: What a reference field accepts from the viewport or the browser.

oneOf.description: A body.
A sketch feature.
One or more closed regions of a sketch.
One or more points of a sketch (point entities, line and arc ends, arc and circle centers).
Faces of a body.
Edges of a body.
An origin plane, a datum plane or a flat face.
An origin axis, a sketch line, a straight edge, or a cylindrical, conical, spherical or toroidal face.

OptionHint.description: Display label for one value of an enumeration field.

PrinterProfile.description:
A printer the model will be printed on. Deserialization fills omitted fields from the
technology's generic profile and validates (section 3.1), so a deserialized profile is always
valid.

id.description: Profile id; validated as a `partsmith_model::Id` by the conversion (`InvalidId`).

technology.description: FDM or resin; selects the generic profile that fills omitted fields.

bed.description: Replaces the whole bed when present.

max_overhang_angle.description: Steepest printable overhang from vertical, in radians.

max_bridge_length.description: Longest unsupported horizontal span in mm.

fit.description: Replaces only the fit classes it names.

Document.description: The document recipe. Geometry is never stored; it is regenerated from this.

format_version.description: Format version; equals FORMAT_VERSION for every document in memory.

units.description: Unit of bare numbers in length expressions, and the display unit for lengths.

printer.description: Printer profile id whose values `printer.*` names resolve to; `None` when no printer is chosen.

parameters.description: Parameters in the order the user sees them.

rollback.description: First rolled-back feature: it and every later feature do not run. `None` means nothing is rolled back.

failed.description: True when some component did not converge; those components keep their previous geometry (sketch.md `SolveResult::failed`).

placement.description: Plane of the sketch in model coordinates.

entities.description: Every entity with solved geometry, in stored order.

points.description: Every addressable point with its solved position, in entity order then role order.

constraints.description: Every constraint's state, in stored order.

regions.description: Closed regions available as profiles, in `build_profile` order (sketch.md).

profile_findings.description: Open endpoints, overlaps, self-intersections and zero-length curves.

messages.description: The solve issues, then one message per entry of `profile_findings` in its order, rendered by the sketch crate in the document units; findings of the stored sketch carry their fixes as actions (engine.md section 3.6).

display.description: Display buffers; absent when the session has display off.

oneOf.description: Some degrees of freedom remain and no constraint is redundant or conflicting.
No degree of freedom remains and no constraint is redundant or conflicting.
Some constraint repeats what others determine; none conflicts.
Some constraints cannot all hold.

SolvedEntity.description: A stored entity with solved coordinates plus its constraint state.

constrained.description: The entity's state from `SolveResult::entity_states`, for coloring.

oneOf.description: A point entity.
A line entity.
A circle entity.
An arc entity.

EntityState.description: Constraint state of one entity, used for coloring.

oneOf.description: Some of its parameters can still move.
All of its parameters are determined.
A conflicting constraint references it.

SolvedPoint.description: A point address and its position in sketch coordinates.

ConstraintState.description: One constraint's state and, for dimensions, its current value.

state.description: The constraint's state after the solve (engine.md 3.6).

value.description: Measured value in mm or radians (dimensional constraints only).

ConstraintSolveState.description: State of one constraint, for constraint glyph coloring.

oneOf.description: Holds in the solved geometry.
Listed in `SolveResult::redundant`.
Listed in `SolveResult::conflicting`.
Belongs to a component that did not converge.

RegionInfo.description: A closed region: the reference a profile param stores, plus its area and centroid.

reference.description: The reference a profile param stores, as `Region::reference()` writes it: key, fingerprint and outline.

RegionRef.description: A stored reference to a region of a sketch.

fp.description: The region's fingerprint when the reference was made.

outline.description:
The region's outer loop in traversal order when the reference was made (section 3.13.8); `None` in references
written before file format version 2. Omitted from JSON when `None`.

ProfileFinding.description: A profile check finding. `render` gives the message of section 4.3 and `Display` the detail of section 4.4.

oneOf.description:
A curve end that touches no other non-construction curve. With `connect`, the finding stands for two open
ends that one coincident constraint would join (section 3.13.3); `connect` is omitted from JSON when `None`.

connect.description: The other open end within `CONNECT_DISTANCE` that this end is paired with.

oneOf.description: Two curves share a stretch of positive length.

entities.description: The two curves, sorted by id.

start.description: Start of the shared stretch in the direction of the first curve.

oneOf.description: Two curves of one connected chain cross at a point inside both.

entities.description: The two curves, sorted by id.

oneOf.description: A curve too short to use; it is ignored.

Connection.description: Two open curve ends within `CONNECT_DISTANCE` of each other. `Display` writes `first,second,gap` (section 4.4).

first.description: The open end the finding names.

second.description: The open end it would be joined to.

gap.description: Distance between the two ends in mm.

Diagnostic.description: A message about a document, feature, sketch or export.

severity.description: Info, warning or error. A feature message of severity info is a notice: its feature's status stays `ok`.

code.description: Stable snake_case code from the crate that produced it.

field.description: JSON Pointer of the feature param the message is about, relative to the feature record (for example `/radius`). Feature messages, and sketch profile findings, whose field is their position in `SketchSolution::profile_findings` (`/profile_findings/0`, section 2.6).

suggestion.description: Replacement expression for `field` that fixes the problem, in document units (for example `2.3 mm`). Feature messages only.

actions.description: One-click fixes computed from the document alone, in the order to offer them (engine.md section 3.22). Omitted when empty.

cause.description: The edit that started the problem, with its own actions (engine.md section 3.21). Session data: absent when the session never saw the feature build without this message, for example in a document opened fresh.

detail.description: Technical text for reports (the kernel's text, the stored reference and the resolver result, a parser's or a panic's text), never shown as the message.

root.description: The root cause a host groups this message under (recompute.md section 3.10, `Message::root`): the first failing feature of an `upstream_failed` chain, of a loss whose reason is `upstream_failed`, or of the feature a `body_empty` or `tool_empty` names as failed; or the sketch that lost its face, or whose face turned over, under a `no_effect`, `hole_misses_body` or `separate_solid`.

reason.description: Why the reference the message names was lost, or which feature a followed or widened reference followed (recompute.md section 3.10, `Message::reason`).

oneOf.description: Worth knowing; does not lower print health.
The part may print badly.
The part will not print or export correctly.

FixAction.description: A fix a host offers as one button.

label.description: Button label starting with a verb, for example "Set Count of 'Linear pattern 1' back to 3".

FixKind.description: What a fix button does. A value enum, so it is tagged `kind`.

oneOf.description: Run `apply_fix` with this reference.
Edit the feature with the field at `path` active, so the next pick replaces the reference.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the field to activate, relative to the feature record.

oneOf.description: Select and frame the feature, and highlight one of its sketch entities when `entity` is set.
Undo the newest undo entry.
Commit the open transaction with `commit_transaction`, then do again what the failed request did (an action of a `transaction_open` error, section 4).

Cause.description: The edit that started a problem (engine.md section 3.21).

text.description: Plain sentence, for example "This started after you changed Distance of 'Extrude 2' from 5 mm to 30 mm."

feature.description: The feature the edit changed, when it changed one (deleted features included).

actions.description: Actions that depend on the session, in order: reverts, Keep the sketch where it was, Undo, Show.

ghost.description: For a sketch entity edit in a display session: the entity as it was before the edit, in the sketch's coordinates. Absent for an added entity, which the sketch itself shows.

Ghost.description: Geometry drawn where something was: a lost element in its last build, a lost region's outline, or a sketch entity before an edit. Positions travel as a binary buffer of the same frame (section 3.4).

positions.description: `f32` positions in mm: 3 per point in `world`, 2 per point (u, v) in `sketch`.

GhostKind.description: How the points of a ghost are joined.

oneOf.description: Line segments, 2 points each (an edge, a region outline, a sketch curve).
Triangles, 3 points each, counterclockwise seen from outside (a face).
Separate points (a vertex, a sketch point).
Model coordinates.
The coordinates of the sketch the ghost belongs to: a region repair's `sketch`, or a cause's `feature`.

LossReason.description: Why a reference was lost, or which feature a followed or widened reference followed: the wire form of recompute.md's `LossReason` (section 3.10), with ids as strings. A value enum, so it is tagged `kind`.

oneOf.description: Not diagnosed.
The feature that made it is not in the document.

feature.description: The feature named by the reference.

oneOf.description: The feature that made it is suppressed.
The feature that made it comes after this one in the timeline.
The feature that made it is at or after the rollback marker.
The feature that made it failed; `root` is the first feature of the chain whose error is its own.

feature.description: The failed feature that made it.

root.description: The first feature of the chain whose error is its own.

oneOf.description: It is in another body, put there by `by` when known (`present`), or the feature that made it now writes another body, so it is no longer in this one (not `present`).

body.description: The body it is in, or that the feature that made it now writes.

by.description: The feature that moved it there, when known.

oneOf.description: A feature between the one that made it and this one removed it.
The sketch entity that made its face was deleted.

feature.description: The feature that made the face from the entity.

sketch.description: The sketch the entity was in.

oneOf.description: A hole no longer uses the point that made it; `deleted` when the sketch no longer has the point.

sketch.description: The sketch the point was in.

deleted.description: Whether the sketch no longer has the point.

oneOf.description: A pattern or mirror no longer makes the copy it was on.

instance.description: The copy it no longer makes.

oneOf.description: An imported file no longer has it.
For a followed or widened reference: the feature whose change it followed.

by.description: The feature whose change it followed.

Removal.description: How a feature removed an element (recompute.md `Removal`). A value enum, so it is tagged `kind`.

oneOf.description: A cut, an intersect or a split took it away.
A join covered it, so it is inside the part.
A fillet rounded it.
A chamfer beveled it.
A shell removed it.
The piece of a split face it was on is gone.
The feature that made it no longer makes it, and why when the feature recorded it.

absence.description: Why the feature no longer makes it, when the feature recorded it.

oneOf.description: Its faces no longer meet; `between` is the name of a face that now lies between them.

between.description: The name of a face that now lies between its faces.

Absence.description: Why a feature does not make a face its naming rule would make (features.md `FeatureOutput::absent`).

oneOf.description: A cut or hole that goes all the way through the body.
A cut or hole whose end reaches the outside of the body while its start lies inside it.
A revolve of a full turn has no caps.

InstanceIndex.description: The instance of a pattern or mirror copy (naming.md `Instance`).

first.description: Index along the first pattern direction, or the only one.

second.description: Index along the second direction; 0 for one-direction patterns, circular patterns and mirrors.

SketchDisplay.description: Buffer indices of the sketch region fills (all coordinates are sketch 2D, mm).

region_ids.description: `u32`, 1 per region fill vertex: index into `regions`.

Dimension.description: Physical dimension as integer exponents of length and angle.

ElementDescriptor.description: Geometry and identity of one B-rep element at the display state.

feature.description: Feature whose output created the element (engine.md 3.9).

reference.description: The reference a feature param stores for this element: the short form (query and fingerprint) in `list_elements`, the full form with anchors and merged names in `pick_reference` (engine.md section 3.9).

centroid.description: Area centroid (faces), length centroid (edges) or position (vertices).

direction.description: Unit direction from the first to the last vertex (line edges only).

axis.description: Axis (cylinder, cone and torus faces; circle edges).

radius.description: Radius in mm (cylinder and sphere faces; circle edges). A sphere's center is its `centroid`.

placement.description: Sketch placement a sketch on this face receives (planar faces only).

fallback.description: `placement` in body coordinates, which hosts store as a face sketch's fallback with `fallback_frame: body` (planar faces only, engine.md section 3.9).

axis_direction.description: Unit axis direction in body coordinates, which hosts store as `direction` when the element is picked for an axis (line edges; cylinder, cone and torus faces; engine.md section 3.9).

adjacent.description: Names of adjacent elements: a face's edges; an edge's faces then vertices; a vertex's edges. Each group sorted by name.

oneOf.description: A plane.
A cylinder.
A cone.
A sphere.
A torus.
A B-spline surface.
Any other surface.

A circle or circular arc.
An ellipse or elliptical arc.
A B-spline curve.
Any other curve.

origin.description: A point on the line, mm.

Resolution.description: The mesh elements one reference resolved to.

MeshElement.description: An element of a displayed mesh.

index.description: Display id of the element within the mesh.

center_of_mass.description: Center of mass at uniform density (bodies).

centroid.description: Area or length centroid, or position (elements).

bounding_box.description: Bounding box of the exact geometry (bodies).

axis.description: Axis (cylinder, cone and torus faces; circle edges).

radius.description: Radius in mm (cylinder and sphere faces; circle edges).

Use.description:
One thing a feature uses (engine.md section 3.24): a feature it links to, or a feature or sketch entity that an
element name in one of its stored references depends on.

field.description: JSON Pointer of the field of `user` that names it, relative to the feature record, for example `/edges/0`.

feature.description: The feature it uses, or whose element it uses.

entity.description: The sketch entity of `feature`'s sketch that made the element used (a lateral face's line, a hole's point).

Health.description: Print health of a body or of everything analyzed. Info findings do not lower it.

oneOf.description: Ready to print.
May print badly.
Will not print or export correctly.

ExportFile.description: A file produced by an export.

CommandResult.description: The success value of every command; its `type` equals the command's `type`.

oneOf.description: Result of `engine_info`.

format_version.description: Newest `.ptsm` format version the engine reads and writes.

kernel.description: Kernel name and version, for example `OCCT 7.9.3`.

oneOf.description: Result of `feature_catalog`.

features.description: Every registered feature type, sorted by type.

oneOf.description: Result of `list_printer_profiles`.

profiles.description: Built-in profiles, then session profiles, each group sorted by id.

oneOf.description: Result of `put_printer_profile`.
Result of `new_document`.
Result of `open_document`.

migrated_from.description: The original `format_version` when a migration ran.

oneOf.description: Result of `save_document`.

assets.description: Every asset the document references, sorted by name.

oneOf.description: Result of `close_document`.
Result of `get_document`.

document.description: The current recipe, including uncommitted transaction edits.

oneOf.description: Result of `mark_saved`.
Result of `apply_edits`.
Result of `rename_parameter`.
Result of `apply_fix`.
Result of `set_document_units`.

revision.description: The revision after the change, unchanged when the units were already `units`.

kept.description: How many expressions and parameters got the old unit.

oneOf.description: Result of `begin_transaction`.
Result of `set_focus`.
Result of `commit_transaction`.

recorded.description: Whether an undo entry was recorded.

oneOf.description: Result of `cancel_transaction`.
Result of `undo`.
Result of `redo`.
Result of `solve_sketch`.
Result of `drag_sketch`.
Result of `end_sketch_drag`.
Result of `set_tessellation`.
Result of `evaluate`.
Result of `list_elements`.

elements.description: Faces, then edges, then vertices, each sorted by name.

oneOf.description: Result of `pick_reference`.

element.description: The picked element, with its full reference.

oneOf.description: Result of `resolve_references`.

results.description: One resolution per reference, in request order.

oneOf.description: Result of `measure`.
Result of `list_uses`.

uses.description:
What every feature uses, sorted by the user's timeline position, then `field`, then `feature`, then
`entity` (absent first).

oneOf.description: Result of `analyze_print`; the full report travels in the `print_health` event.

health.description: Overall health of the analyzed bodies.

oneOf.description: Result of `export`.
Result of `import_step`.
Result of `export_python`.

ErrorCode.description: Stable code of a failed request (protocol.md section 4).

oneOf.description: The bytes are not a valid frame.
The frame is valid but its request is not: unknown command or field, a buffer index out of range or of the wrong element type, or an id above `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
The frame uses another protocol version.
The worker dropped a queued request because a newer one replaced it.
A panic or an engine invariant failure.
The `doc` handle is not open.
The document had an internal error earlier.
The `open_document` text is not a valid document.
The document's `format_version` is newer than this engine reads.
A referenced asset's bytes do not hash to its name.
The command is not allowed while a transaction is open.
The command needs an open transaction.
`apply_edits` outside a transaction has no label.
`apply_edits` inside a transaction has a label.
The model refused an edit, or a parameter rename.
The registry or the sketch crate rejected feature params.
The undo stack is empty.
The redo stack is empty.
A command names a feature that does not exist.
`set_focus` names a suppressed or rolled-back feature.
A sketch command names a feature that is not a sketch.
`drag_sketch` names a point that does not exist.
`end_sketch_drag` without a drag in progress.
`pick_reference` names a mesh that is no longer displayed.
`pick_reference` names a preview mesh.
The pick's index is not below the mesh's element count.
A command names a body that does not exist.
A body has no geometry at the display state.
A reference does not resolve uniquely.
`measure` does not have exactly one target.
An expression does not evaluate.
`analyze_print` names an unknown printer profile.
`put_printer_profile` uses a built-in profile id.
The print crate rejected a profile.
The orientation is not a rotation, or lays a curved face on the bed.
No body qualifies for export.
The writer or kernel failed during export.
The STEP file could not be read or has no solids.
A tessellation tolerance is out of range.
`apply_fix` names a revision other than the document's, or a message or action the feature no longer has, or an action that is not `apply`.

Span.description: A half-open UTF-8 byte range `[start, end)` into an expression's source text.

message.description: Plain sentence for the user, naming the fix where possible.

edit_index.description: Index of the offending edit in an `apply_edits` batch.

span.description: For `expression_error`: the UTF-8 byte range of the problem in the expression text (expressions.md spans). The UI converts it to string indices.

detail.description: Technical text for reports (a panic message, a parser's text), never shown as the message.

actions.description: One-click ways out, in the order to offer them (section 4, for example "Finish \"Fillet\" and save" for `transaction_open`). Omitted when empty.

Response.description: The engine's answer to one request.

id.description: The request id, or 0 when the request id could not be read.

FeatureStatus.description: The recompute status of one feature.

status.description: `ok`, `warning`, `error`, `suppressed` or `rolled_back`. A feature with info notices only is `ok`.

messages.description: The error first, then warnings, then info notices, as engine.md section 3.4 projects them.

repairs.description: Repair data of lost, ambiguous, guessed and widened references and regions, one per repair of each message, in message order: what repair mode shows and replaces (ui.md section 3.7).

FeatureState.description: Outcome of one feature in the last recompute.

oneOf.description: Built without problems, or with info notices only.
Built with warnings.
Failed; its bodies are unchanged.
Skipped because it is suppressed.
Skipped because it is at or after the rollback marker (or after the focused feature).

Repair.description: A reference or region that did not resolve to what it meant: the engine's projection of features.md `Repair` (engine.md 3.4).

oneOf.description: A face, edge or vertex reference.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the feature record, for example `/edges/1`.

body.description: Body the reference is resolved in.

centroid.description: Centroid from the stored fingerprint, for a marker where the element was when there is no ghost.

description.description: The element in words, for example "the front top edge of 'Box 1'".

candidates.description: Possible replacements in candidate order; each is also an action of the message.

ghost.description: Where the element was in its last build, for a dashed outline in the viewport (engine.md section 3.23).

oneOf.description: A profile region.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the feature record, for example `/profile/regions/0`.

sketch.description: The sketch feature the region belongs to.

description.description: The region in words, for example "the region of 'Sketch 1' around (40, 25)".

candidates.description: Sets of regions that could be meant; each is also an action of the message.

ghost.description: The stored outline as it was, in sketch coordinates, for the sketch overlay (engine.md section 3.23).

RepairCandidate.description: A possible replacement for a lost, ambiguous, guessed or widened reference.

reference.description: The reference the "Use" action stores (the full form, with anchors and merged names).

description.description: The candidate in words, for example "the top edge of the cut made by 'Extrude 1'".

relation.description: What it keeps and how far it is, for example "on the top of 'Box 1', 5 mm from where it was".

meaning.description: True when it keeps a face the lost element touched.

distance.description: Distance in mm from where the lost element was.

score.description: Fingerprint score in [0, 1], for reports; hosts never show it.

element.description: The candidate in the body's current model-layer mesh, for highlighting; absent in headless sessions and when that mesh does not have it.

RegionCandidate.description: A set of regions that a lost or ambiguous region reference could mean.

regions.description: The references the "Use" action stores, in the sketch's region order.

description.description: The regions in words, for example "the region of 'Sketch 1' around (175, 10)".

ParameterValue.description: The evaluated value of one parameter.

value.description: Value in internal units; absent when evaluation failed.

dimension.description: Dimension of the value; absent when evaluation failed.

Layer.description: Which rendering layer a mesh belongs to.

oneOf.description: The pickable model at the display state.
The non-pickable result of the focused feature.

MeshBuffers.description: Buffer indices and counts of one body's display mesh (protocol.md section 3.4 lists the invariants).

indices.description: `u32`, 3 per triangle, counter-clockwise seen from outside.

face_ids.description: `u32`, 1 per mesh vertex: display face id.

edge_positions.description: `f32`, 3 per point, line list: 2 points per edge segment.

edge_ids.description: `u32`, 1 per edge segment: display edge id.

vertex_ids.description: `u32`, 1 per displayed B-rep vertex marker: display vertex id.

bounding_box.description: Bounding box of the exact B-rep.

summary.description: The status bar badge over all analyzed bodies.

bodies.description: One entry per analyzed body, in document order.

HealthSummary.description: The status bar badge for everything analyzed.

health.description: Worst health over the bodies; `ok` when there are none.

BodyPrint.description: The print analysis of one body.

transform.description: Column-major 4 × 4 matrix from model to bed coordinates.

mesh_id.description: The model-layer mesh that the overhang map and the findings' `triangles` and `faces` refer to (display sessions only).

overhang.description: `f32`, 1 per mesh vertex of `mesh_id`: overhang angle from vertical in radians, 0 where not overhanging.

report.description: The print crate's report: health, and per check its status, findings and omitted count.

BodyReport.description: All check results for one body.

health.description: Error if any check has an error, else warning if any has a warning, else ok.

checks.description: One result per requested check, in canonical order.

Rotation.description:
A proper rotation (orthonormal, determinant +1) applied to the body before checks.
Deserialization validates.

CheckResult.description: The outcome of one check on one body.

status.description: Worst severity among its findings, including omitted ones; `ok` when none.

findings.description: At most `MAX_FINDINGS_PER_CHECK` findings, in the check's order.

omitted.description: Findings not listed because of the cap; they have the check's listed severity.

oneOf.description: Watertight, manifold, consistently oriented, not inside out, no zero-area triangles.
The part fits the build volume.
Enough of the part touches the bed and it stands steadily.
No part starts printing in mid-air.
Downward faces are not steeper than the printer allows.
Walls are thick enough to print.
Pins, details and holes are wide enough to print.
No sealed cavities.

CheckStatus.description: Result state of a check or a body.

oneOf.description: No findings.
Only info findings.
At least one warning and no errors.
At least one error.

Finding.description: One problem found by a check.

code.description: What kind of problem it is.

message.description: Plain sentence naming the problem and the fix (section 3.9).

value.description:
The measured value (mm, mm², mm³, radians or a ratio, per code); omitted when there is
none.

limit.description: The limit `value` was compared with; omitted when there is none.

triangles.description: Affected triangles of the analyzed mesh, sorted, merged, possibly empty.

faces.description: Distinct face ids of the affected triangles, ascending.

suggestion.description: A suggested fix; omitted when there is none.

FindingCode.description: Stable identifier of a finding's kind.

oneOf.description: Edges used by only one triangle.
Edges used by more than two triangles.
Edges whose two triangles face opposite ways.
The closed mesh has negative volume.
Triangles without area.
The footprint does not fit the bed.
The footprint fits only when turned 90 degrees about Z.
The part is taller than the build height.
No face rests on the bed.
Too little of the footprint rests on the bed.
The part is tall compared with its bed contact.
Printing starts in mid-air.
A downward face steeper than the limit.
A wall thinner than the limit.
A pin, rib or text stroke narrower than the limit.
A hole narrower than the limit.
A sealed cavity.

Location.description: Where the viewport zooms for a finding, in model coordinates.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned box.
A single point.

TriangleRange.description: Half-open range of triangle indices `[start, end)` in the analyzed mesh.

end.description: One past the last triangle in the range.

Suggestion.description: A suggested fix with geometry the UI can show.

oneOf.description: Split the part along these planes, in order.
Put a drain hole near this point (model coordinates).

Event.description: A state change caused by the request answered in the same frame. Tagged by `type`; every event carries `doc` and the document `revision` it describes.

oneOf.description: The recipe and undo state.

document.description: The full current recipe, including uncommitted transaction edits.

dirty.description: Whether the canonical text differs from the dirty baseline: the opened text, or the text named by the latest effective `mark_saved`.

undo.description: Label of the entry `undo` would revert.

redo.description: Label of the entry `redo` would reapply.

bare_numbers.description: How many expressions and parameters are numbers without a unit whose meaning the document units decide (model.md `bare_numbers`), so hosts can offer Keep sizes with its count (engine.md section 3.25).

oneOf.description: Status of every feature in timeline order, every parameter value, and document diagnostics.

features.description: One status per feature, in timeline order.

parameters.description: One value per parameter, in document order.

diagnostics.description: Messages about the document as a whole.

oneOf.description: A sketch whose solution changed.
A datum plane whose result changed.

placement.description: The plane; absent when the feature failed.

oneOf.description: The display mesh of one body in one layer.

layer.description: The layer the mesh belongs to.

mesh_id.description: Id of this mesh; picks and resolutions name it.

mesh.description: The buffers; absent when the body has no geometry in this layer.

oneOf.description: The report of one `analyze_print`.

BufferInfo.description: Location of one buffer inside the frame's buffer section.

offset.description: Byte offset from the start of the buffer section; a multiple of 8.

length.description: Length in bytes; a multiple of the element size.

ElementType.description: Element type of a raw buffer. All multi-byte values are little-endian.

oneOf.description: Unsigned bytes (file contents).
Unsigned 32-bit integers (indices, element ids).
IEEE 754 binary32 floats (positions, normals, analysis values).
